Talent0_2Ability.name: Iron-blooded Commander
Talent0_2Ability.SpecificEffects: Can use command skill <skill mainSkill=301350>[Marshall Edict]</skill>. When actively attacking with a Sniper Rifle, triggers <color=#F74848>2</color> <buf ID=900148>[Ricochet]</buf>, dealing <color=#F74848>25%</color> original DMG each.

Talent3_5Ability.name: Iron-blooded Commander
Talent3_5Ability.SpecificEffects: Can use command skill <skill mainSkill=301350>[Marshall Edict]</skill>. When actively attacking with a Sniper Rifle, triggers <color=#F74848>3</color> <buf ID=900148>[Ricochet]</buf>, dealing <color=#F74848>30%</color> original DMG each.

300001.name: Sniper Warfare 1
300001.SpecificEffects: When destroying a target, <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> can be triggered, effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn. Unable to move before attacking.

301302.name: Pincer Tactics
301302.SpecificEffects: After actively attacking, <buf ID=3013504>[Personal Aide]</buf> launches a <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf> on the same target, dealing <color=#F74848>0.3x</color>. This effect can trigger <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn. This <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf> does not require allies to possess a specific skill and does not consume any Link times.

301303.name: Disrupting Shot
301303.describe: Uses a Sniper Rifle to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>1.2x</color> DMG. Upon triggering <buf ID=900148>[Ricochet]</buf>, deals <color=#F74848>75%</color> Splash DMG to parts other than the part hit.

301304.name: Diplomacy
301304.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=3013504>[Personal Aide]</buf> gains command skill <skill mainSkill=301304>[Servitude]</skill>

301305.name: Wise Leader
301305.SpecificEffects: Reduces <buf ID=3013504>[Personal Aide]</buf> chance to be critically hit by <color=#F74848>15%</color>. When traversing within <color=#F74848>3</color> adjacent tiles of <buf ID=3013504>[Personal Aide]</buf>, movement cost is reduced by <color=#F74848>50%</color>.

301306.name: Blood Oath
301306.describe: Selects an empty tile within <color=#F74848>3</color> adjacent tiles, teleports <buf ID=3013504>[Personal Aide]</buf> to that tile and grants <buf ID=3013061>[Loyalty]</buf> to them. Can continue to act with remaining movement.

301307.name: Strategic Marshal
301307.SpecificEffects: Critical Hit chance increases by <color=#F74848>15%</color>. During <buf ID=900148>[Ricochet]</buf>, Critical Hit chance additionally increases by <color=#F74848>15%</color>.

301308.name: Extermination Order
301308.describe: Uses a Sniper Rifle to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>1.4x</color> DMG. Enters <buf ID=900014>[Aiming]</buf> Mode before attacking. <buf ID=900148>[Ricochet]</buf> count increases by <color=#F74848>+2</color>. If <buf ID=3013504>[Personal Aide]</buf> is within <color=#F74848>3</color> adjacent tiles, this attack and <buf ID=900148>[Ricochet]</buf> ignores target's <buf ID=900160>[DMG Reduction]</buf> effect.

hiddenSkills.name: Landslide Shot
hiddenSkills.describe: Uses a Sniper Rifle to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>1x</color> DMG. Enters <buf ID=900014>[Aiming]</buf> Mode before attacking.

300011.name: Sniper Warfare 2
300011.SpecificEffects: After breaking a part, trigger <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>.

300021.name: Sniper Warfare 3
300021.SpecificEffects: Upon triggering <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>, allows movement of <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles before attacking.

300022.name: Power Innovation 2
300022.SpecificEffects: When breaking a part, restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

301231.name: Hunting Mark 1
301231.SpecificEffects: When actively attacking and breaking parts with a ranged weapon, gains <buf ID=900141>[Hunting]</buf> according to the part hit. Can trigger <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

301234.name: Hunting Mark 2
301234.SpecificEffects: After actively attacking and destroying a target with a ranged weapon, can additionally move <color=#F74848>3</color> tiles.

301235.name: Hunting Mark 3
301235.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900142>[Hunting Mark 1]</buf> no longer has trigger limit

301236.name: Hunting Mark 4
301236.SpecificEffects: At the start of action, randomly gains <color=#F74848>1</color> of unobtained <buf ID=900141>[Hunting]</buf> buffs.

301341.name: Conqueror Will 1
301341.SpecificEffects: When initiating combat, if <buf ID=900148>[Ricochet]</buf> count is <color=#F74848>2</color> or more, triggers <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>, allowing movement of <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles before attacking. This effect can trigger <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

300043.name: Power Innovation 3
300043.SpecificEffects: When destroying a target, additionally restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

301344.name: Conqueror Will 2
301344.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900148>[Ricochet]</buf> prioritizes hitting the same part as the first attack.

301345.name: Conqueror Will 3
301345.SpecificEffects: When attacking with a Sniper Rifle, DMG dealt and Hit Rate are increased by <color=#F74848>10%</color>.

301346.name: Conqueror Will 4
301346.SpecificEffects: While <buf ID=3013504>[Personal Aide]</buf> is present, Sniper Rifle range increases by <color=#F74848>+1</color> and <buf ID=900148>[Ricochet]</buf> count increases by <color=#F74848>+1</color>.
